# Independent Books
> Free, open-source (MIT), offline double-entry accounting software with GST billing and Tally Prime keyboard shortcuts.

Canonical host: https://idpbook.com
Source: https://github.com/PrimeSteelIndia/independent-books
Licence: MIT

## Facts
- No subscription, no per-user or per-company fee, no telemetry.
- Data stored in a local SQLite file; backend binds to 127.0.0.1.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, Android via LAN/PWA.
- GST: automatic CGST+SGST (intra-state) or IGST (inter-state).
- Migrates from Tally Prime via XML import.
